resources.string: Assign a VPN profile to each card. Switching mobile data in the phone changes this network’s profile automatically. Activate an eSIM before adding it. An unassigned card leaves this network unavailable.
No additional active cards. Enable the SIM or eSIM in phone settings, grant Phone permission, then try again.
Add at least one Card name and VPN profile for each automatic SIM network.
Automatic SIM profiles require Android 11 or later and Phone permission.
Choose an existing VPN profile. A card cannot use a load-balance profile.
